headline: Denso and Lumax Industries Grapple with Ransomware, Halting Plant Operations
body: In a significant cybersecurity breach, Denso has stopped production at key facilities following a ransomware attack that targeted its manufacturing control systems. This incident has brought their operations to a standstill as experts work tirelessly to resolve the issue. The impact of the attack has also extended to Lumax, which reported disruptions in its supply chain processes associated with the incident. Both companies are collaborating with cybersecurity firms to regain full functionality, though no timeline has been disclosed.
